Mrs. Fisher: Yes, I always need to size up my fishing gear because of them. Such a bother.
Lady Annalie: I think I will manage. {f_botName}! Could you deal with her makeup?
Bot: Sure, no problem.
Mrs. Fisher: It tickles. 
Mrs. Fisher: This seems like a serious competition. What happened to the absent model?
Lady Annalie: She ate a fish in Thailand and now her stomach hurts.

You: The show is about to start so I will join the rest of the crowd. Good luck.

I hope they will make it in time…
